top_categories.workout_context: 399 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
At Deccan Cliffhanger, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 399 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
399 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
19,381ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Deccan Cliffhanger's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Deccan Cliffhanger's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 19,381ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Deccan Cliffhanger's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 399 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Deccan Cliffhanger. Train it until it feels boring.
19,381ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Low-cadence force work for 19,381ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.heat: November in Pune to Bogmallo Beach, Goa, India can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Deccan Cliffhanger. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Ultra-distance fueling for 399 miles requires a practiced resupply plan built around confirmed course services and available commercial stops. Rehearse frequent carbohydrate intake on long rides, then scale the plan to intensity, sleep strategy, tolerance, and real food across the full event. Carry redundant fuel and avoid applying a short-event hourly target or fixed total-calorie estimate to a multi-day race.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Over Under, and Endurance to prepare you for 399 miles of mixed terrain in Pune to Bogmallo Beach, Goa, India.
